answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 4163 Country: Pakistan Title: I m studying in sweden. so can we use second hand (used crockery) from the market... or not? If we use then what we should do? thanks in anticipation.. Question: I m studying in sweden. so can we use second hand (used crockery) from the market... or not? If we use then what we should do? thanks in anticipation.. Answer ID: 4163 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 223/223=M) If the second-hand crockery has no apparent impurity then it can be used without washing, but it better to first wash and clean it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
